Re: Warranty

The warranty covers manufacturing defects for 24 months from the purchase date. Accidental damage is never covered. Tomas Pajari bought a coffee machine on June 12, 2025. Tomas made a warranty claim on November 28, 2027.

The technician found a faulty heating element from the factory. Tomas registered the machine online.
